statement: This sketch creates an immersive underwater landscape using WebGL rendering to achieve deep-sea depth and fluid motion. The composition features hundreds of organic, glowing shapes that slowly pulse and rotate in three-dimensional space, mimicking the gentle movement of deep ocean currents. Bioluminescent vein structures flow through the scene, creating a network of light that pulses with rhythmic timing. The entire visualization is self-contained and continuously evolving without any user interaction, creating an atmospheric experience that evokes the mysterious, timeless quality of the deepest ocean depths. The color palette emphasizes deep blues and purples with luminous highlights, while the constant motion gives the impression of vast, unseen forces at work beneath the surface.
